en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: If it is said: Your claim of the long life of your Patron [Imam Mahdi (a.s)] is extraordinary,
as according to you, he remains a man of complete intelligence, strength and youthful looks,
because he is, according to you, at this time in 447 A.H., a hundred and ninety-seven years old,
as his birth was in 256 A.H.
